record.name: YouTube Transcript
record.one_liner: A managed REST API and MCP server for extracting YouTube transcripts, search, channel data, and playlists.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free account to receive 100 free credits without a credit card.
record.api_note: Covers YouTube transcripts, video search, channel search, channel videos, latest uploads, and playlist videos.

evidence.quote: Stop fighting YouTube blocks. Get transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP
TranscriptAPI docs use Bearer token authentication.
100 free credits to try the API — no card required.
Transcripts, search, channels, playlists — all in one place.
Get a free API key at transcriptapi.com/signup
